evidence.fact: Typed Components/Search resolver confines changes to private preparation.
All matching input candidates are counted; ambiguity throws and absence remains nil. A control is indexed only when count is exactly one.
Any present control must have a canonical label, enabled state and finite target frame of at least48points before any selected skip can return.
Components skip requires public selected==true from the unique observed Button. It makes no touch and intentionally does not claim full visibility or hittability.
The unselected action path reacquires observation, requires whole safe viewport inclusion and native hittability, and issues one tap only.
Posttap polling queries a fresh unique Components observation and returns only a newly confirmed selected control. Failure or timeout throws; no retap exists.
Keyboard regions are all collected; inputView and assistant identifiers also collect all existing matches independently of a Keyboard node.
Each bounded backward gesture has a new observation and derived safe start/end. A control observed below the viewport cannot trigger an opposite-direction sweep.
The existing bound remains at most twelve short backward scrolls. Missing or ambiguous state is not replaced by .first.

limitations: No SDK build or test execution was performed by this reviewer.
No device, UI, Native retry, app source change or file edit was performed.
This source approval does not establish actual native selected-state delivery, gesture consumption or an Editor62 pass.
